description.summary: You call forth Gilgamesh, a traveling sword collector who brandishes one of his four swords upon your enemies
description.value: You call forth Gilgamesh, a traveling sword collector who brandishes one of his four swords upon your enemies. Roll a 1d4, on a 1, Gilgamesh draws out Excalipoor and deals 1 damage to all enemies within the area of effect. On a 2, Gilgamesh draws out Excalibur and deals 1d6 points of holy damage per level, a Reflex save for half damage. On a 3, Gilgamesh draws out Masamune and deals 1d8 points of non-elemental per level, a Reflex save for half damage. On a 4, Gilgamesh draws out Zantetsuken and instantly kills all enemies, a Fortitude save to negate.
